source.title: A Time to Kill
source.description:
I feel that I've learned so much in so short a time. I don't think anyone could ever truly be ready to face what I intend to face, but I feel as ready as I'll ever be. What say you, <name>? Shall we go and end this fight?

I'm not sure where to begin, but I suspect we'll find clues somewhere in the Eastern Plaguelands. We should probably start in areas where the Cult of the Damned congregates.
source.progress: Vengeance is near, I can feel it!
source.completion: It seems that we've found our quarry, but he seems to be out of our reach. We must discover a way to reach him so that we may strike.
